batting.name: G Gambhir
batting.dismissal: c Yuvraj Singh b VRV Singh

batting.name: S Dhawan
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b B Lee

batting.name: Shoaib Malik
batting.dismissal: c B Lee b VRV Singh

batting.name: MK Tiwary
batting.dismissal: c Yuvraj Singh b VRV Singh

batting.name: KC Sangakkara
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b Mohammad Asif

batting.name: TM Srivastava
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b VY Mahesh

batting.name: IK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b Mohammad Asif

balls.text: Maharoof makes room and squeezes it out to Jayawardene at long-off, he fumbles and Maharoof scampers for the second run, the throw is fast and flat and Sangakkara whips off the  bails with Maharoof well short of his ground
another slower ball, he exposes his stumps and punches it down to deep cover
fired on the blockhole outside off, he makes room and digs it out to mid-off
the slower bouncer, really deceives Maharoof as he withdraws the pull stroke
Maharoof makes room again and carves a fullish delivery down to long-off, they run quickly and complete the second run
the slower ball, Yomahesh intelligently taps it wide of the bowler and gets off strike
expensive over there by Lee, Maharoof makes room and scoops a fullish delivery just in front of the long-off rope, nobody patrolling the area to get a hand to it
the yorker outside off this time, he digs it out towards mid-off
fast yorker on the pads, he digs it out to the on side
the slower ball, Lee pitches it on the wrong length on middle and leg and Maharoof makes room and lofts through the line well wide of the long-on fielder
gets the swinging yorker on the pads and he just manages to squeeze it out to fine leg, Lee appeals but gets no support

the slower ball, he fends it softly towards Katich at short third man, Katich flicks it at the stumps and surprisingly Punjab delay their appeal, Maharoof just gets his back in, third umpire has a look
ends the over with a fast swinging yorker and Maharoof manages to dig it out
bangs it in short, it's the slower ball this time, Tiwary tries to flat-bat it over the bowler's head but gets  a thick top edge to Yuvraj at mid-on
he holds the length back this time but Tiwary makes room and clubs this safely over midwicket, one bounce and four
streaky, but he'll take it, he makes room to slog it through the on side but gets an inside edge which beats the stumps and short fine leg comfortably
makes room again and squeezes out another yorker to cover
makes room and squeezes out a yorker towards point, Katich has a shy at the stumps, a direct hit would have had Maharoof packing but there was nobody to back the throw
fullish outside off, he makes room and carves it on the first bounce to third man
walks across his stumps and pushes a full delivery past cover
digs it in short, he leans back and upper cuts it on the first bounce to third man
Pathan pitches it bang in line of middle stump and the ball holds its line, Bhatia tries to dab it down ti third man but has no room to work with as the ball clips the top of middle stump
similar delivery, this time he drives to deep point
tempts him to go for the wild drive through the covers but the ball it too wide to make contact
starts off with a yorker on offstump, he gets his bat down and squeezes it out to mid-off
much better, he pitches it on middle, Bhatia clips it wide of midwicket for a single
Sreesanth comes round the wicket but it doesn't help as Bhatia puts away a low full toss and whips it wide of square leg, he bisects the gap between deep square leg and long leg
shot! Sreesanth pitches it on a length for Bhatia to swing his arms and he does so by carting it high over deep midwicket
he walks across his stumps to paddle this past short fine leg but fails to pick the yorker, he tamely tucks it towards midwicket
aims for the yorker but dishes out a low full toss, he gets forward and punches it through the line down to deep extra cover
full and wide outside off, he reaches out and drills it down to deep cover
ouch! Lee digs in a nasty bouncer and the ball lobs off the helmet as he takes his eyes off the ball and tries to hook, Bhatia stayed forward for that bouncer
fuller this time, he stays back at the crease and pushes this down to long-on
Lee digs it in short and fractionally wide, he makes room and flat bats it over backward point, effective stroke there
fires in that inswinging yorker and strikes him on the base of the pad outside leg, the ball rolls towards third man
slower delivery again, pitches it shorter, he swivels and pulls to deep square leg, that's the 100
the slower ball, he picks it early and pushes it just in front of mid-off for a quick single
gets back and punches through the line to long-off
pushed back straight, Yuvraj dives and stops that
defends on the front foot, Sanga gets rather chirpy behind the stumps, he wants the batsmen to go for the lofted shots
pitches on middle and straightens, he can't whip it through the on side
slides wide down the leg side
hops back and clips it wide of midwicket
full outside off, the fielder at cover dives and intercepts
pitches on middle and leg, he pushes it through the line to long-on
gets this one to straighten and tucks up Bhatia, he manages to defend
pitches on middle and leg, he pushes it through the line to long-on
pitches outside off, he cuts towards point
good shot, gets on his knee early and drags that from outside off and places it wide of deep square leg, there's a despairing dive
starts off with a googly, he picks it well and defends
Yuvraj pushes it quicker on middle and off and gets it to straighten, Karthik shapes to pull that over square leg and gets a thick inside edge which takes out his legstump
driven through the line to deep cover
pitches outside off, he opens the face and steers it wide of short third man
flighted on middle and leg, he gets down and slogs it wide of midwicket
loops it down the legside and Karthik follows the line early, he gets on his knees and places it wide of short fine-leg
flights it outside off, he drives through the covers
fullish and wide outside off, he drives past point
full and wide outside off, he leans forward and scoops this over extra cover
cramps him for room outside off, the ball straightens and he slashes and misses
Chawla gives it too much air and dishes out a full toss, Karthik scoops it off the middle of the bat and clears long-off
false shot by Tiwary as he gets width outside off and slashes hard and misses
gets back at the crease and taps it to the off side
good length outside off, he taps it wide of backward point
that was a real brute of a delivery, really stifled Karthik as he hopped to fend it off, the ball lobbed off his glove and just beat the keeper
he bangs it in short and wide outside off, he can't resist the upper cut but he controls it and places it wide of Lee at third man
pitches on middle and leg, he shuffles and tucks it down to the on side
the googly, well bowled by Chawla as the turn beats Tiwary as he shapes to cut
he fails to put away a half volley by driving straight to cover
pitches outside off, he drives to cover
gives him more width outside off, he reaches out and drives it wide of point
full and wide outside off, he drives it to cover
gets down too early for the sweep and the ball hits him on the pad, Chawla appeals half-heartedly
tempts him with width outside off and he nearly feathers it through to the keeper as he attempts to dab it down to third man
keeps it short of a length and cuts back in high on Tiwary, he fends it off towards the off side and defends
keeps it short, he fends it off easily to the on side and sets off
VRV bangs it in short and really stifles Tiwary as he hops and fends it off uneasily, he's late to set off for a single and VRV throw at the non-striker's end is off target
pitches on off and nips back in, he defends very close to his pads, the ball nearly rolls onto the stumps

Delhi are losing the plot here! VRV bangs it in short and wide outside off, Malik eyes a six over third man but doesn't put much power on the stroke and ends up tamely upper-cutting it down Lee's throat at third man
gives him width outside off and Malik plays a deft glide past short third man, he looks in good touch, Delhi need him to stick on
slides down the leg side, he loses his direction there
gets forward and pushes it back to the bowler
steps down the track, it's a googly and he checks his stroke and defends
hits him on the pads just over the line of middle stump, there's a stifled appeal from the bowler
slightly shorter, he hops back and tucks it towards square leg
pitches it on middle, no turn, he defends

sudden rush of blood for Gambhir as he gives VRV the charge, the ball is pitched short and as a result Gambhir fails to go through with the loft over mid-off and gives Yuvraj an easy catch running back a few paces
Malik walks across his stumps very early before VRV delivers, he flicks it straight to short fine-leg
good comeback, he keeps it short and cramps him for room, Malik attempts a cheeky steer to third man and nearly gets an edge
that was a gift outside off, short and wide, not coming through with much pace, he reaches out and slices it high over backward point
holds the length back outside off, he steps down and tries to cream it through the offside but mistimes it to mid-off
hits a good length outside off, he punches this to cover
full and wide outside off and he drives firmly through the line to cover, Sreesanth gets away with that
he errs by straying on the pads and that's all too easy for Gambhir as he clips it wide of midwicket off the middle of the bat
goes for the drive through the on side a little too early and ends up getting a thick edge onto his boot, the ball rolls to the offside
fullish and swinging away, he pushes it softly towards point
holds the length back, he gets forward and taps it just in front of mid-off and sets off quickly, the under arm flick just misses the stumps
Malik welcomes Sreesanth with a smashing offdrive past mid-off, that was a little too wide outside off
slower ball, he opens the face of the bat and dabs it to third man
dishes out a bouncer and Malik hooks and misses, umpire Koertzen says that was too high
short and wide outside off, he cuts hard but there's protection for him at deep cover
that was a cracker! Pathan gives him too much width outside off and Gambhir frees his arms and cuts hard past cover, that rocketed off the bat
misfield, Pathan cramps him for a bit of room outside off but Gambhir adjusts well and thuds it hard off the bat towards point, Katich misreads the bounce and lets it slip through
steps down the track and checks his stroke as he taps it back to the bowler
taps it softly towards Katich at cover, he has a shy at the non-striker's end and hits the stumps, they steal an overthrow with nobody to back the deflection off the stumps
holds the length back on middle and off, he tucks it to the on side
the slower ball, moves away after pitching and beats Malik on the forward prod
classic shot to get off the mark, it was fractionally wide outside off and moving away, he times it crisply past backward point

Lee bangs one in short down the leg side and that really climbs on Dhawan as he shapes to hook, replays show the ball brushing the shoulder before reaching Sangakkara, Dhawan was clearly disappointed with Koertzen's decision
excellent running, Gambhir taps it in front of the stumps very softly and calls immediately, Dhawan responds and sets off very quickly
pitches on a length outside off, he punches it towards point
pitches outside off, he slashes it on the first bounce to slip
poor running, Dhawan taps it towards short cover and Gambhir sets off at the other end for a non existent single, Gambhir was lucky the throw at his end was wide

pitches just short of a length on middle and leg and straightens, Sehwag hops on his toes and tries to whip it the on side but the ball strikes him flush on the pads, umpire Shivaram is convincedd this time, the height is the question there
gets one to nip back in and cramp him for room, he gets back and defends back to Pathan
pitches outside off, he taps that wide of cover

appeal for a leg before! Pitches in line of offstump and comes back in and appears to hit the stumps as Sehwag misses a heave to the on side, replays showed that it would have hit, umpire Shivaram wasn't convinced
Irfan gets aggressive and  bowls a bouncer, that sails over Sehwag's arched back, wide called
much fuller and moving away, he reaches out and places that to third man
Lee loses his line by pitching it too short and wide, Sehwag frees his arms and cuts that over the slips
varies the length by bowling a yorker, Gambhir just manages to get his bat down and keep it out
bangs it in short and Sehwag does well to get on his toes and defend that with soft hands to the offside, that allows a quick single
comes back inwards and Gambhir clips it very close to the pads on the on side, there's a bit of inward movement for Lee
good carry to start off with, pitches on the channel outside off and seams back in slightly before reaching the keeper
slides on the pads and he sweeps wide of square leg to seal the win
tries to tuck it wide of midwicket but pushes it back to Malik
gets down and plays a neat defensive push to the covers
Yuvraj clubs this one past the bowler but there's protection at long-on
slower ball, he turns the face of the bat and clips it to deep midwicket
good stuff, he tucks him up with a short delivery and Lee has to hop to fend it off
dishes out a bouncer and Lee arches under it
pulls a short delivery on on leg but places it straight to deep midwicket
shapes to cut square on the offside but misses

charges down the track and tries to finish it off in style but gets a thick edge as he tries to club it past the bowler, Karthik leaps up and gathers it, Umpire Sivaram raises the finger after a while and Asif gives Pathan a bit of a send-off
take that! Asif pitches it short and Pathan swivels and pulls with intent past square leg, that just rocketed off the bat
full outside off, he pushes this to long-off
exposes his stumps and clubs it to long-off, Pathan makes a gesture to the umpires that there were only 3 fielders in the circle and umpire Sivaram duly signals that a no  ball
closes the face of the bat and flicks this towards midwicket
pitches on middle, he nudges it off his pads to the on side
terrible fielding at the deep, Pathan cuts hard at a delivery wide outside off and Dhawan at sweeper cover over runs it and makes a mess of it
slices it down to backward point and retains the strike
slightly short, he punches it hard to Malik at short cover, Yuvraj is out of the crease and makes a despairing dive back at his crease, Malik doesn't throw
pitches it short and wide outside off, he shapes to slice this over the keeper but is beaten for the extra yard of pace and gets a thick edge to Karthik
pushes this in the arc between mid-on and midwicket
gives him width outside off and Yuvraj makes room and crashes that past extra cover off the backfoot
Srivastava makes room and tries to free his arms, he slices it on the up and heads towards Asif at mid-off, he mistimes his dive and the ball slips through and nearly reaches the fence
defended to the offside
comes round the wicket, Yuvraj taps it to backward point, an overthrow results in a single, Yuvraj isn;t happy with his partner's running
Shot of the tournament? Yuvraj makes room and sees a full delivery on middle and leg, he chips it effortlessly and places it over long-off, it was like a defensive push going for six
lands on a good length outside off, he gets across and taps it wide of cover
bangs it in short and Yuvraj manages to get on top of the bounce and pull it down to deep midwicket
the slower ball, Yuvraj waits on it and cuts it square to sweeper cover
bangs it in short and slides just down leg, Srivastava hops and gloves it past the keeper
good ball, bangs it in short and gets it to rear up on Srivastava who fends it off to point
shuffles at the crease and whips it to the on side
tries to cream a full delivery past the bowler but Yohamahesh does well to slide and get a hand to it, saved  a boundary
Srivastava turns it to the offside

very tame end to a good innings.... Katich turns a low full toss to midwicket and sets off for a risky run, Sehwag gathers the ball and flings it to Malik who whips off the bails, katich was nowhere in the picture
slides on the pads again, he whips it to deep square leg
slides on the pads this time, he moves across and paddles it away to fine leg
fuller outside off, he drives through the line to long-off
pitches on a length outside off, he taps it down to point
slides wide down the legside, bonus run there
the yorker length, swinging in, he tucks it on the full to midwicket
going, going! He pitches it up outside off and Yuvraj just stays put at the crease and lofts that crisply over long-on, all elegance
bangs it in shorter this time, he swivels and pulls to fine leg
Imperious! Maharoof overpitches outside off and Katich gets across and swings across the line and sends the ball scorching past mid-on
the slower ball, well disguised, he shapes ton pull but plays too early
low full toss, he fails to put it away by placing it straight to mid-on
flat bats it across the line and Maharoof tries to intercept it with his boot, Maharoof claims he didn't see it
Free Hit It's a low full toss and Yuvraj scoops it really high over midwicket, the ball was in the air for ages
oversteps, flighted outside off, he gets forward and pushes it to sweeper cover
rocks back and punches it down to long-off
gets forward and defends
charges down the track and creams it over the straight boundary, a spectator holds the catch at the second tier
looped in on middle and leg, he gets down and sweeps to fine leg, good running
digs in a bouncer, Yuvraj arches under it
pitches outside off, he drives to long-off
holds the length back outside off, he defends to the offside
gets on his knee and drags that from outside off down to midwicket, that was more of a slog
the slower ball, misdirects it wide down the leg side
gets across his stumps and defends back to the bowler
now Maharoof feeds him on the pads and Katich obliges by shuffling across and whipping it wide of deep square leg
tries to sweep, gets caught on the pads
gets forward and defends
cuts back on the pace but errs with the width, he rocks back and cuts square, Gambhir dives but fails to cut it off, he's chatting with the TV commentators at the same time
steps down and drives hard but he can't beat cover
gives him width, he rocks back and cuts it square, that's his 50
flighted on middle and leg, he pushes it to long-on
hits a good length on middle and leg, he tucks it to the on side
good delivery, Katich digs out a yorker to the offside
frustration for Asif as Katich makes use of the width outside off and gets a thick outside edge wide of the slips
pitches wide outside off, he opens the face of the bat and steers it down to third man
gets across his stumps and defends back to the bowler
pitches outside off, the ball holds its line before reaching the keeper
flighted on middle, he tucks it wide of midwicket to get off the mark

Sharp return catch! Jayawardene leans forward to drive but checks his stroke, he ends up chipping it tamely back to Malik who dives low to his right and picks it with both hands just inches off the turf
turns wide down leg, Karthik whips off the bails
flighted on middle and leg, he whips it through the line to deep midwicket
gets down the track, checks his stroke and yet manages to time it crisply, Yomahesh slides from long-on to intercept it
gets a bit of turn, he waits for it at the crease and steers it softly in front of cover
much slower, he gets forward and beats cover, Dhwan picks it up in the deep
strays wide down the leg side, fired in fast
false stroke by Mahela as he flashes at one wide outside off and misses
feeds it on the pads again and this time he places it straight to Bhatia at fine leg
poor line, he feeds it on Katich's strength - on the pads -  and he shuffles across his stumps and glances it to fine leg
he taps it down to the offside with soft hands, Yomahesh attempts an under arm flick but the throw was well over the stumps
Katich shuffles across his stumps again and glances it down to Bhatia at fine leg
pitches outside off, he gets across and taps it to the offside
shot! Gives him width outside off and he rocks back and cuts hard past cover
nearly a return catch! Jayawardene shapes to push this through the on side and checks his stroke, the ball lobs off the meat of the bat and Maharoof stretches out to catch that
pitches outside off and comes back in, he tucks it to the on side
bangs it short and wide, poor ball and Jayawardene makes him pay by slicing it high over cover
short of a length outside off, Jayawardene plays a deft glide and first slip just gets a finger to it, McGrath runs across from third man and just pulls it back
and another! McGrath errs by landing another half volley, Katich whips it harder and creams this past the bowler and mid-on
super shot! It lands on a half volley outside off and Katich drives it straight past mid-off, all timing
low full toss on middle and leg, he pushes it to mid-on
defended to the on side
Appeal! The ball swings in and lands on a yorker length, the ball appears to strike him on the boot, McGrath holds back his appeal, the umpire may have reckoned there was an inside edge
pitches it wide outside off, he opens the face of the bat and dabs it down to third man
three in a row Listen to the crowd! Asif pitches it short this time but it doesn't pay off as he gets across his stumps and pulls down to fine leg
squarer this time, Katich reaches out to another full delivery and scoops it over backward point, Yomahesh runs across from third man to cut it off but his running is slack
Katich improvises by getting across his stumps and scooping a full delivery over extra cover, he gets on his knee and plays the stroke
swings in on the pads, he closes the face of the bat and glances it fine
good ball, pitches outside off and swinging away, Jayawardene has a poke at it
pitches just outside off, he gets across, covers the line and defends
pitches on middle and nips back in, he gets across and clips it wide of midwicket
shuffles across, turns the face of the bat and tucks it just wide of midwicket, Jayawardene is a little slow off the blocks
successive boundaries for Katich as he gets across and dispatches a short delivery by pulling it past short fine leg
full and ewide outside off, not quite McGrath's stock delivery but Katich reaches out and gets a thick outside edge safely past second slip
full on the pads, he gets across and clips it to midwicket
rocks across and punches it hard down to backward point
Game on! Asif pitches it on a good length on  the channel just outside off, the ball kicks up and seams away, Sangakkara opens the face of the bat and gets an edge to Karthik
super shot! Pitches full on off and middle and Sangakkara walks across and plays a crisply timed straight drive past mid-off
gets across and tucks it down to deep square leg, McGrath runs across and cuts it off
pushes it towards mid-on and sets off fast, maharoof hits the stumps at Katich's end but he just makes it to his crease
beats him straight up with an away swinger

Pigeon delivers early! The ball nips back in sharply and slices Goel in half, there appears to be a thick inside edge onto his pads before reaching the keeper, it was first given as a caught behind but changed to a leg before, Koertzen slowly raises the finger. The ball clearly wasn't hitting, not a good decision there
gets across and defends it to mid-off
walks across his stumps again and this time the ball clips his pads and rolls to the on side, McGrath appeals half heartedly for a leg before
gets a long way across his stumps and defends back to McGrath
pitches on a length outside off, he taps  it to the offside
pitches on middle and leg, he tucks it to fine leg
